watchlist.name: ServiceNow
watchlist.thesis: Enterprise workflow + AI Control Tower; system of action for human and agent workflows.
watchlist.risk: Agentic AI could abstract the UI; M&A and SBC discipline matter.

watchlist.name: Zscaler
watchlist.thesis: Zero Trust for users, workloads and AI agents; Agentic SOC + data security.
watchlist.risk: FY27 guide implies ~17% growth; rerating requires organic ARR re-acceleration.

watchlist.name: Rubrik
watchlist.thesis: Cyber resilience + Agent Cloud + recovery / rewind after agent or attack failures.
watchlist.risk: Still GAAP loss-making; high SBC and multiple require >30% growth to persist.

watchlist.name: Fortinet
watchlist.thesis: Secure networking + SASE + AI workload protection; Virtue AI expands agent/runtime security.
watchlist.risk: Valuation is no longer cheap; AI-security purity lower than ZS/CRWD.

watchlist.name: Micron Technology
watchlist.thesis: AI memory cycle, HBM demand and data-center DRAM/NAND growth; new 512GB DDR5 AI-server module reinforces high-capacity memory demand.
watchlist.risk: Highly cyclical memory pricing and capex intensity; Taiwan labor negotiations add a near-term supply-execution risk.

watchlist.name: CrowdStrike
watchlist.thesis: Cloud-native security platform spanning endpoint, identity, cloud, SIEM and AI-agent security.
watchlist.risk: Premium valuation leaves little room for execution misses or multiple compression.

watchlist.name: Snowflake
watchlist.thesis: Enterprise data + AI consumption platform; AI workloads can accelerate product consumption.
watchlist.risk: Premium valuation, high SBC and intense competition from Databricks and hyperscalers.

watchlist.name: Bloom Energy
watchlist.thesis: On-site power for data centers; AI-driven electricity demand can accelerate deployments.
watchlist.risk: Project execution, financing needs, policy exposure and volatile expectations.

watchlist.name: Corning
watchlist.thesis: Optical connectivity and fiber demand from AI data-center buildouts.
watchlist.risk: AI exposure is indirect and broader industrial/display cycles can dilute the thesis.
